observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a used engine assembly with a tapering metal tailshaft housing attached below it, consistent with an engine-and-manual-transmission combination sitting in a crowded yard of other engines/transmissions.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the tapering housing (likely the transmission/gearbox) lying on the ground next to a person's leg for scale; hoses and wiring are still draped over it.
No casting number, parts tag, or identification plate is legible in any photo.
A watermark reading 'GEARUP INC.' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears on all three photos; this is a seller/platform watermark, not proof of the item's identity or condition.
The housing in photo 2 shows a chipped or rough edge near the bottom right corner; it is unclear if this is dirt, casting flash, or actual damage.
Numerous other engines and gearbox-like units are visible in the background of photos 0 and 1, suggesting a busy teardown/parts yard where mix-ups are possible.
No photo isolates the gearbox alone without the engine and wiring harness overlapping it, making it hard to confirm exactly what is being sold versus what is just nearby clutter.
